command.summary: Create an Azure Virtual Machine. For an end-to-end tutorial, see https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/virtual- machines/linux/quick-create-cli.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the virtual machine.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --accept-term
parameters.help: Accept the license agreement and privacy statement.

parameters.name: --add-proxy-agent-ext
parameters.help: Specify whether to implicitly install the ProxyAgent Extension. This option is currently applicable only for Linux OS. Use with --enable-proxy- agent.

parameters.name: --additional-events
parameters.help: The configuration parameter used while creating event grid and resource graph scheduled event setting.

parameters.name: --align-regional-disks
parameters.help: Specify whether the regional disks should be aligned/moved to the VM zone. This is applicable only for VMs with placement property set. Please note that this change is irreversible.

parameters.name: --all-instance-down
parameters.help: Specifies if Scheduled Events should be auto- approved when all instances are down. Its default value is true.

parameters.name: --availability-set
parameters.help: Name or ID of an existing availability set to add the VM to. None by default.

parameters.name: --boot-diagnostics-storage
parameters.help: Pre-existing storage account name or its blob uri to capture boot diagnostics. Its sku should be one of Standard_GRS, Standard_LRS and Standard_RAGRS.

parameters.name: --capacity-reservation-group
parameters.help: The ID or name of the capacity reservation group that is used to allocate. Pass in "None" to disassociate the capacity reservation group. Please note that if you want to delete a VM/VMSS that has been associated with capacity reservation group, you need to disassociate the capacity reservation group first.

parameters.name: --computer-name
parameters.help: The host OS name of the virtual machine. Defaults to the name of the VM.

parameters.name: --count
parameters.help: Number of virtual machines to create. Value range is [2, 250], inclusive. Don't specify this parameter if you want to create a normal single VM. The VMs are created in parallel. The output of this command is an array of VMs instead of one single VM. Each VM has its own public IP, NIC. VNET and NSG are shared. It is recommended that no existing public IP, NIC, VNET and NSG are in resource group. When --count is specified, --attach-data- disks, --attach-os- disk, --boot- diagnostics- storage, --computer-name, --host, --host- group, --nics, --os-disk-name, --private-ip- address, --public- ip-address, --public-ip- address-dns-name, --storage-account, --storage- container-name, --subnet, --use- unmanaged-disk, --vnet-name are not allowed. WARNING: Argument '--count' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --custom-data
parameters.help: Custom init script file or text (cloud-init, cloud- config, etc..).

parameters.name: --data-disk-iops
parameters.help: Specify the Read- Write IOPS for the managed disk when storage account type is UltraSSD_LRS.

parameters.name: --data-disk-mbps
parameters.help: Specify the bandwidth in MB per second for the managed disk when storage account type is UltraSSD_LRS.

parameters.name: --disable-integrity-monitoring-autoupgrade
parameters.help: Disable auto upgrade of guest attestation extension for Trusted Launch enabled VMs and VMSS.

parameters.name: --edge-zone
parameters.help: The name of edge zone.

parameters.name: --enable-agent
parameters.help: Indicates whether virtual machine agent should be provisioned on the virtual machine. When this property is not specified, default behavior is to set it to true. This will ensure that VM Agent is installed on the VM so that extensions can be added to the VM later.

parameters.name: --enable-auto-update
parameters.help: Indicate whether Automatic Updates is enabled for the Windows virtual machine.

parameters.name: --enable-hibernation
parameters.help: The flag that enable or disable hibernation capability on the VM.

parameters.name: --enable-hotpatching
parameters.help: Patch VMs without requiring a reboot. --enable-agent must be set and --patch- mode must be set to AutomaticByPlatform.

parameters.name: --enable-integrity-monitoring
parameters.help: Enable installing Microsoft propietary and not security supported guest attestation extension and enabling System Assigned Identity for Trusted Launch enabled VMs and VMSS.

parameters.name: --enable-proxy-agent
parameters.help: Specify whether metadata security protoco (proxy agent) feature should be enabled on the virtual machine or virtual machine scale set.

parameters.name: --enable-reboot
parameters.help: The configuration parameter used while publishing scheduled events additional publishing targets.

parameters.name: --enable-redeploy
parameters.help: The configuration parameter used while creating user initiated redeploy scheduled event setting creation.

parameters.name: --enable-secure-boot
parameters.help: Enable secure boot.

parameters.name: --enable-vtpm
parameters.help: Enable vTPM.

parameters.name: --encryption-identity
parameters.help: Resource Id of the user managed identity which can be used for Azure disk encryption.

parameters.name: --eviction-policy
parameters.help: The eviction policy for the Spot priority virtual machine. Default eviction policy is Deallocate for a Spot priority virtual machine.

parameters.name: --exclude-zones
parameters.help: If "--zone- placement-policy" is set to "Any", availability zone selected by the system must not be present in the list of availability zones passed with "excludeZones". If "--exclude-zones" is not provided, all availability zones in region will be considered for selection.

parameters.name: --image
parameters.help: The name of the operating system image as a URN alias, URN, custom image name or ID, custom image version ID, or VHD blob URI. In addition, it also supports shared gallery image. Please use the image alias including the version of the distribution you want to use. For example: please use Debian11 instead of Debian.' This parameter is required unless using `--attach-os- disk.` Valid URN format: "Publisher: Offer:Sku:Version". For more information, see ht tps://learn.microso ft.com/azure/virtua l- machines/linux/cli- ps-findimage.
parameters.values_from: az vm image list, az vm image show, az sig image-version show- shared

parameters.name: --imds-access-control-profile-reference-id
parameters.help: Specify the access control profile version resource id resource id of imds.

parameters.name: --imds-mode
parameters.help: Specify the mode that proxy agent will execute on if the feature is enabled.

parameters.name: --include-zones
parameters.help: If "--zone- placement-policy" is set to "Any", availability zone selected by the system must be present in the list of availability zones passed with " --include-zones". If "--include- zones" is not provided, all availability zones in region will be considered for selection.

parameters.name: --key-incarnation-id
parameters.help: Increase the value of this property allows user to reset the key used for securing communication channel between guest and host.

parameters.name: --license-type
parameters.help: Specifies that the Windows image or disk was licensed on-premises. To enable Azure Hybrid Benefit for Windows Server, use 'Windows_Server'. To enable Multi- tenant Hosting Rights for Windows 10, use 'Windows_Client'. For more information see the Azure Windows VM online docs.

parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Location in which to create VM and related resources. If default location is not configured, will default to the resource group's location.

parameters.name: --max-price
parameters.help: The maximum price (in US Dollars) you are willing to pay for a Spot VM/VMSS. -1 indicates that the Spot VM/VMSS should not be evicted for price reasons. WARNING: Argument '--max-price' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --os-disk-secure-vm-disk-encryption-set
parameters.help: Specify the customer managed disk encryption set resource ID or name for the managed disk that is used for customer managed key encrypted Confidential VM OS disk and VM guest blob.

parameters.name: --os-disk-security-encryption-type
parameters.help: Specify the encryption type of the OS managed disk.

parameters.name: --patch-mode
parameters.help: Mode of in-guest patching to IaaS virtual machine. Allowed values for Windows VM: AutomaticByOS, Auto maticByPlatform, Manual. Allowed values for Linux VM: AutomaticByPlat form, ImageDefault. Manual - You control the application of patches to a virtual machine. You do this by applying patches manually inside the VM. In this mode, automatic updates are disabled; the paramater --enable- auto-update must be false. AutomaticByOS - The virtual machine will automatically be updated by the OS. The parameter --enable-auto- update must be true. AutomaticByPlatform - the virtual machine will automatically updated by the OS. ImageDefault - The virtual machine's default patching configuration is used. The parameter --enable-agent and --enable-auto- update must be true.

parameters.name: --platform-fault-domain
parameters.help: Specify the scale set logical fault domain into which the virtual machine will be created. By default, the virtual machine will be automatically assigned to a fault domain that best maintains balance across available fault domains. This is applicable only if the virtualMachi neScaleSet property of this virtual machine is set. The virtual machine scale set that is referenced, must have platform fault domain count. This property cannot be updated once the virtual machine is created. Fault domain assignment can be viewed in the virtual machine instance view.

parameters.name: --ppg
parameters.help: The name or ID of the proximity placement group the VM should be associated with.

parameters.name: --priority
parameters.help: Priority. Use 'Spot' to run short-lived workloads in a cost-effective way. 'Low' enum will be deprecated in the future. Please use 'Spot' to deploy Azure spot VM and/or VMSS. Default to Regular.

parameters.name: --proxy-agent-mode
parameters.help: Specify the mode that proxy agent will execute on if the feature is enabled. WARNING: Option '--proxy-agent-mode' has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use '--wire-server-mode' instead.

parameters.name: --scheduled-events-api-version
parameters.help: Specifies the api- version to determine which Scheduled Events configuration schema version will be delivered.

parameters.name: --secrets
parameters.help: One or many Key Vault secrets as JSON strings or files via `@{path}` containing `[{ "sourceVault": { "id": "value" }, "v aultCertificates": [{ "certificateUrl": "value", "certificateStore": "cert store name (only on windows)"}] }]`.

parameters.name: --security-type
parameters.help: Specify the security type of the virtual machine.

parameters.name: --size
parameters.help: The VM size to be created. See https: //azure.microsoft.c om/pricing/details/ virtual-machines/ for size info.

parameters.name: --ssh-key-name
parameters.help: Use it as public key in virtual machine. It should be an existing SSH key resource in Azure.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --user-data
parameters.help: UserData for the VM. It can be passed in as file or string.

parameters.name: --v-cpus-available
parameters.help: Specify the number of vCPUs available.

parameters.name: --v-cpus-per-core
parameters.help: Specify the ratio of vCPU to physical core. Setting this property to 1 also means that hyper- threading is disabled.

parameters.name: --validate
parameters.help: Generate and validate the ARM template without creating any resources.

parameters.name: --vmss
parameters.help: Name or ID of an existing virtual machine scale set that the virtual machine should be assigned to. None by default.

parameters.name: --wire-server-access-control-profile-reference-id
parameters.help: Specify the access control profile version resource id of wire server.

parameters.name: --wire-server-mode
parameters.help: Specify the mode that proxy agent will execute on if the feature is enabled.

parameters.name: --zone
parameters.help: Availability zone into which to provision the resource.

parameters.name: --zone-movement
parameters.help: Indicates if zone movement is enabled. By default isEnabled is set to false i.e VM can't be moved from one zone to another.

parameters.name: --zone-placement-policy
parameters.help: Specify the policy for virtual machine's placement in availability zone.

parameters.name: --admin-password
parameters.help: Password for the VM if authentication type is 'Password'.

parameters.name: --admin-username
parameters.help: Username for the VM. Default value is current username of OS. If the default value is system reserved, then default value will be set to azureuser. Please refer to https://le arn.microsoft.com/r est/api/compute/vir tualmachines/create orupdate#osprofile to get a full list of reserved values.

parameters.name: --authentication-type
parameters.help: Type of authentication to use with the VM. Defaults to password for Windows and SSH public key for Linux. "all" enables both ssh and password authentication.

parameters.name: --generate-ssh-keys
parameters.help: Generate SSH public and private key files if missing. The keys will be stored in the ~/.ssh directory.

parameters.name: --ssh-dest-key-path
parameters.help: Destination file path on the VM for the SSH key. If the file already exists, the specified key(s) are appended to the file. Destination path for SSH public keys is currently limited to its default value "/hom e/username/.ssh/aut horized_keys" due to a known issue in Linux provisioning agent.

parameters.name: --ssh-key-type
parameters.help: Specify the type of SSH public and private key files to be generated if missing.

parameters.name: --ssh-key-values
parameters.help: Space-separated list of SSH public keys or public key file paths.

parameters.name: --host
parameters.help: Resource ID of the dedicated host that the VM will reside in. --host and --host-group can't be used together. WARNING: Argument '--host' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --host-group
parameters.help: Name or resource ID of the dedicated host group that the VM will reside in. --host and --host- group can't be used together. WARNING: Argument '--host-group' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --assign-identity
parameters.help: Accept system or user assigned identities separated by spaces. Use '[system]' to refer system assigned identity, or a resource id to refer user assigned identity. Check out help for more examples.

parameters.name: --role
parameters.help: Role name or id the system assigned identity will have.

parameters.name: --scope
parameters.help: Scope that the system assigned identity can access.

parameters.name: --plan-name
parameters.help: Plan name.

parameters.name: --plan-product
parameters.help: Plan product.

parameters.name: --plan-promotion-code
parameters.help: Plan promotion code.

parameters.name: --plan-publisher
parameters.help: Plan publisher.

parameters.name: --workspace
parameters.help: Name or ID of Log Analytics Workspace. If you specify the workspace through its name, the workspace should be in the same resource group with the vm, otherwise a new workspace will be created. WARNING: Argument '--workspace' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --accelerated-networking
parameters.help: Enable accelerated networking. Unless specified, CLI will enable it based on machine image and size.

parameters.name: --asgs
parameters.help: Space-separated list of existing application security groups to associate with the VM.

parameters.name: --nic-delete-option
parameters.help: Specify what happens to the network interface when the VM is deleted. Use a singular value to apply on all resources, or use `<Name>=<Value>` to configure the delete behavior for individual resources. Possible options are Delete and Detach.

parameters.name: --nics
parameters.help: Names or IDs of existing NICs to attach to the VM. The first NIC will be designated as primary. If omitted, a new NIC will be created. If an existing NIC is specified, do not specify subnet, VNet, public IP or NSG.

parameters.name: --nsg
parameters.help: The name to use when creating a new Network Security Group (default) or referencing an existing one. Can also reference an existing NSG by ID or specify "" for none ('""' in Azure CLI using PowerShell or --% operator).

parameters.name: --nsg-rule
parameters.help: NSG rule to create when creating a new NSG. Defaults to open ports for allowing RDP on Windows and allowing SSH on Linux. NONE represents no NSG rule.

parameters.name: --private-ip-address
parameters.help: Static private IP address (e.g. 10.0.0.5).

parameters.name: --public-ip-address
parameters.help: Name of the public IP address when creating one (default) or referencing an existing one. Can also reference an existing public IP by ID or specify "" or '' for None ('""' in Azure CLI using PowerShell).

parameters.name: --public-ip-address-dns-name
parameters.help: Globally unique DNS name for a newly created public IP.

parameters.name: --public-ip-sku
parameters.help: Public IP SKU. The public IP is supported to be created on edge zone only when it is 'Standard'.

parameters.name: --subnet
parameters.help: The name of the subnet when creating a new VNet or referencing an existing one. Can also reference an existing subnet by ID. If both vnet- name and subnet are omitted, an appropriate VNet and subnet will be selected automatically, or a new one will be created.

parameters.name: --subnet-address-prefix
parameters.help: The subnet IP address prefix to use when creating a new VNet in CIDR format.

parameters.name: --vnet-address-prefix
parameters.help: The IP address prefix to use when creating a new VNet in CIDR format.

parameters.name: --vnet-name
parameters.help: Name of the virtual network when creating a new one or referencing an existing one.

parameters.name: --attach-data-disks
parameters.help: Attach existing data disks to the VM. Can use the name or ID of a managed disk or the URI to an unmanaged disk VHD.

parameters.name: --attach-os-disk
parameters.help: Attach an existing OS disk to the VM. Can use the name or ID of a managed disk or the URI to an unmanaged disk VHD.

parameters.name: --data-disk-caching
parameters.help: Storage caching type for data disk(s), including 'None', 'ReadOnly', 'ReadWrite', etc. Use a singular value to apply on all disks, or use `<lun>=<vaule1> <lun>=<value2>` to configure individual disk.

parameters.name: --data-disk-delete-option
parameters.help: Specify whether data disk should be deleted or detached upon VM deletion. If a single data disk is attached, the allowed values are Delete and Detach. For multiple data disks are attached, please use `<data_disk>=Delete <data_disk2>=Detach ` to configure each disk.

parameters.name: --data-disk-encryption-sets
parameters.help: Names or IDs (space delimited) of disk encryption sets for data disks.

parameters.name: --data-disk-sizes-gb
parameters.help: Space-separated empty managed data disk sizes in GB to create.

parameters.name: --disk-controller-type
parameters.help: Specify the disk controller type configured for the VM or VMSS. WARNING: Argument '--disk-controller-type' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --encryption-at-host
parameters.help: Enable Host Encryption for the VM or VMSS. This will enable the encryption for all the disks including Resource/Temp disk at host itself.

parameters.name: --ephemeral-full-caching
parameters.help: Specify whether or not to enable full caching for this VM/VMSS which will cache the OS disk locally on the host and make this VM/VMSS more resilient to storage outages.

parameters.name: --ephemeral-os-disk
parameters.help: Allows you to create an OS disk directly on the host node, providing local disk performance and faster VM/VMSS reimage time.

parameters.name: --ephemeral-os-disk-placement
parameters.help: Only applicable when used with `--ephemeral-os- disk`. Allows you to choose the Ephemeral OS disk provisioning location.

parameters.name: --os-disk-caching
parameters.help: Storage caching type for the VM OS disk.

parameters.name: --os-disk-delete-option
parameters.help: Specify the behavior of the managed disk when the VM gets deleted i.e whether the managed disk is deleted or detached.

parameters.name: --os-disk-encryption-set
parameters.help: Name or ID of disk encryption set for OS disk.

parameters.name: --os-disk-name
parameters.help: The name of the new VM OS disk.

parameters.name: --os-disk-size-gb
parameters.help: OS disk size in GB to create.

parameters.name: --os-type
parameters.help: Type of OS installed on a custom VHD. Do not use when specifying an URN or URN alias.

parameters.name: --source-disk-restore-point
parameters.help: Create a data disk from a disk restore point. Can use the ID of a disk restore point.

parameters.name: --source-disk-restore-point-size-gb
parameters.help: The size of the source disk restore point in GB.

parameters.name: --source-resource
parameters.help: Create a data disk from a snapshot or another disk. Can use the ID of a disk or snapshot.

parameters.name: --source-resource-size
parameters.help: The size of the source disk in GB.

parameters.name: --specialized
parameters.help: Indicate whether the source image is specialized.

parameters.name: --storage-account
parameters.help: Only applicable when used with `--use-unmanaged- disk`. The name to use when creating a new storage account or referencing an existing one. If omitted, an appropriate storage account in the same resource group and location will be used, or a new one will be created.

parameters.name: --storage-container-name
parameters.help: Only applicable when used with `--use-unmanaged- disk`. Name of the storage container for the VM OS disk.

parameters.name: --storage-sku
parameters.help: The SKU of the storage account with which to persist VM. Use a singular sku that would be applied across all disks, or specify individual disks. Usage: [--storage- sku SKU | --storage-sku ID=SKU ID=SKU ID=SKU...], where each ID is "os" or a 0-indexed lun.

parameters.name: --ultra-ssd-enabled
parameters.help: Enables or disables the capability to have 1 or more managed data disks with UltraSSD_LRS storage account.

parameters.name: --use-unmanaged-disk
parameters.help: Do not use managed disk to persist VM.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http:// jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
